caveats: Up to first8 actual airborne and first8 actual racket contacts in original TRAIN order, plus fixed69/112/0 references and first failure if otherwise missing; posthoc contact selection, not a random sample. All128 metrics retained.
Actual50Hz Native poses/ball and exact original contact events; no interpolation or new physics.
Episode durations may end early under original rule/root termination; all recorded first-episode frames are retained.
Final freeze is labelled the last actual50Hz sample, not an exact terminal physics state.
Original recovery scoring retained; the earlier stochastic TRAIN69 flag observation is not transplanted here.
Fixed per-case orthographic cameras fit the actual recorded mesh bounds; exact contact has a separate fitted camera. This is a visual replay update, not a new experiment.
View labels and time labels sit outside the420px image panes; viewport coverage does not assert that every mesh surface is unoccluded.
camera_projection: orthographic, side12-degree elevation, exact-contact30-degree oblique and vertical top
